articles.title: Why Your $200/mo AI Coding Subscription is a Mathematical Scam: Developer-Centric Guide
articles.description: Data from frustrated developers shows how AI SaaS subscriptions use hidden rate limits and silent model downgrades to cap your productivity, plus a practical guide on bypassing ecosystem lock-in and taking control of your API costs with Frugaast.

articles.title: Stop Merging AI Slop: Ship Faster Without the Technical Debt
articles.description: "Vibe coding" is a great party trick, but autonomous agents are quietly filling your codebase with unmaintainable, over-engineered garbage. Here is why experienced engineers are abandoning the autonomous hype to put their hands back on the steering wheel.
